news.headline: Wall Street slides: Nasdaq -2.1%, S&P -1.1% as chip stocks tumble
news.what_happened: Nasdaq fell 2.1% to 26,140 (worst week since June, -4.5%); S&P 500 -1.1% to 7,659; Dow -0.3%. Micron -5.6%, Intel -5.8%. US 10Y yield at ~5.10%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off cue for India and a negative read-through for IT, which rallied ~4% on Friday and is vulnerable to profit booking. High US yields add FII outflow risk.

news.headline: Crude eases: WTI -1.6% to $97.45, Brent -1.8% to $107.91
news.what_happened: Oil fell for a session but remains very elevated near $100.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude helps input costs for airlines, paints and tyres; negative for upstream ONGC/OIL margins. Level is still high, so relief is modest.

news.headline: Nifty closes at 23,146 (+0.65%), second straight gain led by IT (+4%)
news.what_happened: Sensex +414 pts to ~74,729. Midcap index slipped 0.12%. USD/INR at 94.95, rupee weaker ~0.45% vs prior close.
news.why_it_matters: Nifty enters Monday after a sharp IT-led move; with Nasdaq down, a gap-down or giveback in IT is plausible. Weaker rupee partly cushions exporters but hurts airlines.

news.headline: Asia mixed: Hang Seng +0.5%, Nikkei -1.2%
news.why_it_matters: No clear Asian risk-on lead; China data not a major driver today.

sector_outlook.reason: Crude -1.6%, though weaker rupee offsets partly
Nasdaq -2.1% after 4% Friday rally; profit booking risk
US risk-off and 5.1% US yields vs. domestic strength
Mixed Asia, no fresh China catalyst

picks.catalyst: Crude -1.6% overnight; stock fell 1.9% on Friday
picks.logic: Jet fuel is ~35-40% of airline OPEX, so lower crude directly lifts margins. Friday's dip gives a mild mean-reversion setup. Weaker rupee is a partial offset, so target kept modest.
Crude derivatives are ~40-50% of paint raw material cost; a falling crude trend supports margin expectations.
Synthetic rubber and carbon black derive from crude (60-70% of input cost); lower crude is a margin tailwind.

risks: GIFT Nifty and FII/DII data could not be verified this morning; check the opening gap before entering
Nasdaq -2.1% and US 10Y at ~5.1% raise risk of a gap-down and IT profit booking
Crude still near $100; a rebound would reverse all three picks
Rupee weakness (USD/INR 94.95) is a headwind for airlines
eod_summary: 1/3 hit target (APOLLOTYRE +1.72%); INDIGO +0.21% direction right, ASIANPAINT -0.05% flat/miss. Nifty closed 22888.95 (-1.11%) on risk-off.
